_what: Judgements about (ticked criterion, open issue) pairs found by scripts/criterion-issue-census.ts. The census column is mechanical — an open issue NAMES this criterion. Everything in this file is a judgement somebody made, and carries who and when. An entry stops applying when the criterion's fingerprint moves; see lib/criterion-issue-census.ts.
_signing: `by` is the actor who read the issue and decided, never the person who would own the fix. `rayford` is an agent.

Recorded because the sweep's classification was wrong and this is where that is visible.

#1162 names SC-453 only inside a Related line pointing at #1161, 'SC-453 ticked without an implementation', and makes no claim of its own. BUT THAT IS THE INTERESTING PART: the contradiction is recorded in #1161, which is CLOSED, and this census reads open issues only — so a criterion contradicted by a closed issue is invisible to it.
